modeling_decisions: Retain pyramidal summit and cirque hollows from concept. Simplify concept detailed talus and secondary pinnacles into one compact four-face summit. Four sharp short ridges separate physically concave faces. One closed terrain surface volume avoids nested cliff/terrain skin overlaps. No snow/trees/water used to imply identification.
repair_design: Actual r001 hero/top/clay inspected: silhouette too soft/conical. r002 keeps original scope, makes four true planar-sided pyramidal faces with physical cirque concavity and cardinal convergent ridges; no camera/material/depth trick.
